run_evaluation: run the SQuAD dataset evaluation script to compute exact match scores on predictions
evaluate_predictions: evaluate predictions against ground truth answers using exact match or regex scoring
run_regex_evaluation: run the evaluation script with regex matching instead of exact match for predictions
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that compares predictions to ground truth answers and prints exact match score
summarize_evaluation_script: summarize the SQuAD v1.1 evaluation script that reads JSONL dataset and prediction files
